name: uniquedomains
description: One plugin from Unique Domains. It connects your assistant to stored facts about domain names, TLDs, registrar prices and the domain market, and adds a skill that tells it which tool answers which question.

plugins.name: unique-domains
plugins.description: Ask about a domain name, an ending (TLD) or a registrar. The answers are stored facts from the record Unique Domains keeps: status, registry record, prices, market totals, naming trends and events.
